description: In the specified two-point counterexample, \(E\) relates every pair, and every operation \(F:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}\) of every finite arity preserves \(E\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.EqualityAxioms.bad_equivalence_and_functions :
  (∀ (a b : Bool), Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.E a b) ∧
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (F : (Fin n → Bool) → Bool) (a b : Fin n → Bool),
      (∀ (i : Fin n), Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.E (a i) (b i)) →
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.E (F a) (F b)
